newsitem.title: USA: Allegiant raises qtly div, sets stock div.
newsitem.headline: Allegiant raises qtly div, sets stock div.

text.p: Allegiant Bancorp Inc said Thursday that it is increasing its quarterly cash dividend rate by 32 percent, beginning with the regularly quarterly dividend payable in April 1997.
The regular $0.025 per share dividend will rise to $0.03 starting in the first quarter of 1997, the company said.

The company said its board also declared a 10 percent tax-free common stock dividend to shareholders of record on January 2, payable January 15. The dividend will raise the number of shares outstanding to 2,196,174 from 1,996,522, the company said.
